subject: PayPath Collector — vendor master intake & PO routing

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: PayPath Collector — vendor master intake & PO routing

Hi Theo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to move forward. To get PayPath set up in our vendor master so we can issue the initial PO, we need a short packet of information. Can you provide the following by end of day Thursday?

- Legal entity name (as registered)
- Billing address and remit address (if different)
- Primary AP contact name, email, and phone
- Remit instructions (ACH account or wire; routing details preferred in secure form)
- W9 (or local tax equivalent) and a copy of the vendor onboarding form (attached below is our intake template if helpful)

If you want, you can reply and attach the docs or send a secure link to procurement@paypathcollector.com and cc me. Once we have the info, I’ll route to Finance to create the vendor record and confirm the PO number.

Next steps from our side: Marissa from Procurement will take the lead on master-data ingestion and will reach out with any follow-ups.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we have a supplier kickoff scheduled for next Tuesday.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_VendorIntake_Template.pdf (form)

Thanks, Theo — got the docs and the summary. Forwarding internal checklist and next actions below.

Internal checklist (Procurement -> Finance handoff):
- Verify W9 details match legal entity on onboarding form (completed)
- Create vendor master record in ERP (NetLedger) with legal name PayPath Collector, Inc. (in progress)
- Set remit channel: ACH; flag wire as backup
- Add AP contact: Alicia Reed (accounts@paypathcollector.com) and set PO acceptance email to accounts@paypathcollector.com
- Add vendor note: prefer PO field "project code" to include PP-RED-001

Theo — two quick clarifications so Finance can finish the record:
1) Can you confirm the full ACH account number via our secure upload link? I will send a short expiring link to procurement@paypathcollector.com.
2) For invoicing cadence: do you prefer consolidated monthly invoices or per-deliverable invoices?

If I don’t hear back by end of day Friday, I’ll proceed with the current info and Finance will provision a provisional vendor ID so Jordan can issue the PO.

Marissa Cole
Senior Procurement Specialist
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_procure_handbook_excerpt.pdf (reference)

For invoicing cadence, please confirm whether you want monthly consolidated invoices or invoices per milestone; either is fine but Finance needs confirmation before we finalize payment terms.

Jordan — when you issue the PO, include: Vendor ID VND-2026-1829, project code PP-RED-001 in the PO description, and send the PO to accounts@paypathcollector.com.

Laura Bennett
